plainTranslation: Their Saturn in your 3rd house: they bring weight to your daily exchanges; depth and seriousness, or criticism that makes you guard your words. Failure mode: feeling censored or talked down to. Welcome the gravity; refuse the silencing.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
